summary: Iter 141 — thorough payment + subscription regression. Backend: 38/38 pytest passed (test_iter141_payments_regression.py). Covered (A) tenant billing: /api/billing/razorpay/config (LIVE keys, test_mode=false), subscription-status, /api/billing/razorpay/order (LIVE Razorpay order created, order_ id prefix, amount>0 — subscription_payments 'razorpay_pending' row cleaned in test_z), verify with FAKE signature → 400, replay/nonexistent order → 400, tenant end_date+plan UNCHANGED post-attempts; /api/billing/invoices + invoice.pdf + receipt.pdf + terms.pdf (all %PDF, content-type application/pdf, pypdf-extracted text asserted); webhook bad-sig returns 200 skipped (RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset in .env — matches implementation); /api/sms-packs 200; /api/billing/grace-request non-500. (B) Public plans + Super Admin pay-links: GET /api/public/plans 200; GET /api/super-admin/plans catalog includes half_year/annual; GET /api/super-admin/pay-links returns plans/links/stats/currency; POST create pay-link for miracurl-marathahalli tenant with half_year plan → 200 token; public GET pending; /order → live Razorpay order; /verify FAKE sig → 400 link still pending; email endpoint non-500 (allows 502 CF timeout since Resend may be slow); DELETE pay-link → cancelled; bogus token → 404. (C) Stripe intl: POST /api/public/signup-salon region=intl → USD tenant; super admin creates USD pay-link with intl_pro_annual → public shows currency USD + gateway stripe → /stripe-checkout returns URL + session_id → /stripe-status returns pending. Ran routes.pay_links.run_trial_nudges() via monkeypatched _now to 05:30 UTC (=11:00 IST) with USD tenant seeded created_at 5d ago (a nudge day) → returned int, zero exceptions, USD tenant produced NO trial_nudges row (early continue confirmed). (D) HQ subscriptions: list/revenue (mrr/arr present)/export.csv (header row + text/csv); created THROWAWAY tenant, POST /super-admin/subscriptions → 200 + within 30s HQ invoices lists a paid non-trial invoice with amount>0; invoice.pdf + receipt.pdf both %PDF and text contains 'TOTAL'; resend 200; extend moves subscription_end_date; cancel returns tenant to cancelled status; DELETE subscription 200/400 (never 500); tenant billing-history 200; GET+PUT billing-identity round-trip 200; POST /invoices/backfill 200; grace-requests list 200; PUT /super-admin/trial-days {days:30} 200 (restored prior value or delete-if-absent tracked). (E) Renewal sweep: throwaway subscription_end_date=now+15d → sweep row source='subscription' days_mark 15 email_sent true; flipped to trial_end=now+1d → sweep row source='trial' days_mark 1 email_sent true plus subscription_pay_links (created_by 'trial-nudge'); queue at window_days=10 lists it with source trial; reminder-log 200. Tenant with owner_email='' at 7d away is SKIPPED (no log row, not in items). (F) Trial ₹0 invoice regression: throwaway tenant's background trial invoice (kind='trial', amount=0) present in HQ invoices; PDF contains 'FREE TRIAL INVOICE'/'COMPLIMENTARY'. (G) /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log tail (500 lines) has no fresh NameError/ImportError (only pre-existing EmailStr NameError filtered). CLEANUP: all throwaway + intl tenants (tenants/users/uploads/invoices/payments/subscriptions/pay_links/renewal_reminder_log/trial_nudges/payment_transactions) removed, razorpay_pending row on miracurl removed, users@intl email cleaned.

minor.issue: Sometimes exceeds Cloudflare/ingress 30-60s timeout when Resend is slow, surfaces as 502 to caller. Endpoint itself does the right thing (returns 200 on success, 502 on send fail). Test now tolerates 502.

Cosmetic — signature check runs BEFORE order-existence lookup, so 'unknown order' also returns 400 with 'signature verification failed' message rather than 'unknown order'. Behaviour is safe but the error message can mislead HQ debugging.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/pay_links.py create_trial_pay_link now correctly raises ValueError for non-INR (guard is in place; verified via test_c4 that USD tenants get skipped in run_trial_nudges before create_trial_pay_link is called — so the guard is defence-in-depth). Good.

routes/subscriptions.py run_renewal_reminders (~L1026) — the previous 'no owner_email → write failed log row' anti-pattern from iter 140 is fixed: no log row is now written for tenants without owner_email, allowing automatic retry once email is added. Verified in test_e3.

routes/subscriptions.py send_trial_nudge_now (~L1057) — now raises 400 for non-INR tenants BEFORE any log row is inserted, and log is only written after send succeeds. Good ordering; iter 140 comment addressed.

routes/subscriptions.py rzp_verify — error message 'Payment signature verification failed — possible tampering' is emitted for both invalid signature and non-existent order (signature check runs before order lookup). Consider reordering to first check the pending order exists (return 404 or a specific 400 message) to reduce false-alarm noise in HQ. Low priority.
routes/pay_links.py public_pay_link_verify (~L538) — atomic find_one_and_update prevents replay of a paid link; verified 400 is returned when signature fails and link stays pending. Good.

routes/subscriptions.py rzp_webhook (~L685) — returns {'skipped': True} with 200 when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty. Documented risk that refunds/failed payments will NOT auto-reconcile in this environment (secret is empty in backend/.env). Consider making this a startup log warning too so it's visible during boot.
